contents.text: What was Oracle's combined net income for fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026?

Oracle's combined net income for fiscal 2025 and fiscal 2026 was $12,443 + $17,087 = $29,530 million. (Source: ORCL-10K-2026.html, PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules and PART IV > Item 15. Exhibits and Financial Statement Schedules)
